prompts.prompt: Turn my messy meeting notes into a well-organized document with sections for decisions, action items, and open questions: [rough notes].
prompts.expected: Fires this skill. Groups related points regardless of original order, produces real section headings, and flags any ambiguity in the source rather than resolving it silently.

prompts.prompt: I have a bunch of half-written sections about our project — can you organize this into one coherent document?
prompts.expected: Fires this skill. Finds the natural structure across the fragments and organizes them into a properly headed document respecting formatting.heading_depth.

prompts.prompt: Reformat this document to use our usual heading style — deeper nesting and bullets for lists.
prompts.expected: Fires this skill. Applies formatting.heading_depth and formatting.style concretely to restructure the existing document.

prompts.prompt: Turn these three bullet points into a short paragraph: - launched in March - grew to 10k users - now profitable
prompts.expected: Does not fire this skill. Small enough to stay a single short paragraph — writing-assistant's job.

prompts.prompt: Summarize this 10-page article into three bullet points.
prompts.expected: Does not fire this skill. Condensing an already-polished source is source-summarizer's job, not restructuring rough notes.

prompts.prompt: Create a Word document from this content with a table of contents and page numbers.
prompts.expected: Does not fire this skill. Producing a specific file format (.docx) with format-specific features is the docx skill's job.
